result.title: Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting for Online Reconstruction
result.comment: accepted to WACV 2027, project page: https://linus-franke.com/hibs/
result.summary: Online 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs a scene during capture: each keyframe spawns primitives once and refines them for only a few dozen iterations, leaving little chance to fix poor initialization or missing detail. Gaussians are also inherently soft, needing many overlaps for solid surfaces. We present Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting (HIBS), which brings beta kernels to incremental reconstruction. Their shape parameter interpolates between a soft, Gaussian-like profile and a flat-topped, near-opaque surfel, acting as a confidence dial for geometry. Our confidence-aware spawning uses geometric observability and multi-view depth agreement to initialize both opacity and shape, producing solid primitives where geometry is verifiable and soft, correctable primitives where it is not. As online densification, error-driven relocation recycles stale primitives into photometric-error hotspots. Bounded beta kernel support enables exact tile culling and faster rasterization, and a closed-form, shape-preserving merging formulation provides a level-of-detail (LOD) hierarchy for fast optimization and real-time rendering. On Mip-NeRF 360 in the on-the-fly protocol, HIBS improves PSNR by up to 0.8 dB while reducing optimization time by up to 40%. Project page: https://linus-franke.com/hibs/

AI.brief_summary: 面向在线 3D 重建，将 beta 核引入增量式 Gaussian Splatting，用可观测性与多视角深度一致性决定新基元的不透明度与形状软硬，并配合误差驱动的重定位和保形合并的 LOD 层级。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按证据强度给每个状态单元设定软硬/置信」的做法可能启发 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态可靠性的区分表述，但领域较远，仅概念层面可核查。
